about: What this person told voters in each campaign since 2016: their campaign website as saved by the Wayback Machine just before election day (the homepage and the pages about where they stand), as text, and their campaign-season Bluesky and Threads posts. From scripts/collect-campaign-text.mjs; the promises in it are found by step 2.
name: Sanford D. Bishop, Jr.

pages.title: Sanford Bishop for Congress
pages.text:
## A proven leader
working for you.
## Fighting for Middle and Southwest Georgia
30 years ago, the people of Georgia’s Second Congressional District put their faith in me to represent them in Congress. While much has changed since then, I remain as grateful, humbled, and committed as ever to serve you.
During my time as your Congressman, I have done my dead level best to have a positive impact on all that reside in Middle and Southwest Georgia. But my work is far from over — we must continue our fight to build a better Georgia.
I am convinced that together we can do great things, and that with your help, we can ensure the American Dream remains accessible to all.
About Congressman Bishop
## A Moderating Voice in Congress
This campaign is a movement for the people — for voting rights and civil rights, for farmers and ranchers, for students and teachers, for men and women of all races and creeds to pursue equality, prosperity, and the American dream.
## Help Us Cross the Finish Line
P.o. Box 909
Columbus, GA 31902
